title: Permission audit tracing and immutable event contract for RBAC v2
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Define and ship an RBAC v2 permission model that couples a clear resource/scopes/permissions matrix with an immutable, tamper-evident audit event contract (v1) to support post-hoc investigations, compliance, and automated policy debugging. This ticket covers the schema proposal for audit events, mapping SSO/SAML claims to role bindings at auth time, admin elevation controls, and a phased migration plan for existing role bindings.
background: We need explicit, machine-readable audit trails for every authorization decision so security teams and incident responders can reconstruct 'who had what right to what resource when' without needing to stitch multiple logs together. Current logs are spread across API gateway logs, application traces, and ad-hoc DB audit tables. RBAC v2 rollout provides a good inflection point to standardize an immutable authorization event record that is tenant-aware, minimal (to avoid PII over-logging), and supports cryptographic integrity checks for high-assurance customers.
proposed_solution_summary: 1) Introduce a canonical PermissionDecision event schema (audit_event.v1) emitted synchronously from the authorization layer for every decision (ALLOW/DENY/ELEVATION). 2) Augment the RBAC model with explicit 'scope anchors' mapped to resource path patterns and a compact permission matrix. 3) Map SAML/SSO assertions to role bindings at login and surface ephemeral role claims for short-lived sessions. 4) Implement an append-only event sink (immutable ledger backed by write-once storage + periodic signing) for high-compliance SKUs.
permission_matrix_examples: Scopes: read, write, deploy, admin, billing, audit.read
Example role 'Project Maintainer' => scopes [read, write, deploy]; bound to /org/42/project/*
Example role 'Security Auditor' => scopes [audit.read]; bound to /org/* (read-only across projects)
Deny precedence: explicit denies on a resource override inherited allows from parent scopes
audit_event_contract: Fields (audit_event.v1): event_id (UUID), timestamp (ISO8601), tenant_id, principal_id, principal_type, principal_source (SSO|API_KEY|SERVICE), action (string), resource_path, requested_scope, decision (ALLOW|DENY|ELEVATION), policy_path_or_rule_id, reason (optional), request_id (correlation), token_hash_prefix (to link to token but avoid storing token), ksig (signature over canonical payload)
Minimal PII: do not include username/email in event payloads unless explicitly requested by customer via opt-in retention label
Immutable handling: events written to append-only store and signed by service key; rotation of signing key recorded in a signed key-rotation record
Retention/Export: default 90 days for hosted tier, configurable up to 7 years for enterprise; provide one-click export for compliance audits
sso_saml_mapping: At SSO login, translate SAML groups/claims to ephemeral role assertions (TTL 15m) and persist a binding record in AuthorizationStore for auditability
Claim precedence: admin mapped via 'is_admin' claim takes precedence but requires 2FA/SCIM sync proof for long-lived admin assignments
Provisioning: support SCIM push to seed role bindings for enterprise customers, with updates emitting a binding-change audit_event.v1
admin_controls: Break-glass flow: emergency elevation requires 2-step approval and emits ELEVATION events with justification; TTL limited to 4 hours and audited
Temporal elevation: granular scope elevation can be granted for specific resource paths for limited durations via the Console or API
Delegation: allow scoped delegation (grantor, grantee, scope, expires_at) with audit trail and automatic revocation hooks
migration_plan: Phase 0 - Design review and API contract sign-off (this ticket)
Phase 1 - Emit audit_event.v1 in parallel (write-only) from new auth layer while continuing current logs (2 weeks)
Phase 2 - Backfill historical bindings for last 90 days into immutable store for internal customers and validate queries (3 weeks)
Phase 3 - Switch console/analytics to read from canonical events and gradually deprecate old log sources (1 sprint)
Phase 4 - Offer enterprise immutable ledger and signing for customers requiring tamper-evidence (commercial rollout)
Rollback plan: if gaps found, revert stepwise to Phase 1 and keep both stores for an additional 30 days
test_plan: Unit tests for canonical serializer/deserializer of audit_event.v1
Property tests to ensure deterministic canonical payload for signing across languages/regions
Integration test: trigger decisions (allow/deny/elevation) and assert event written, signed, and queryable
Load test: ensure authorization layer emits events at peak qps without increasing p50 latency >5ms
Security test: key-rotation and signature verification tests, and verify minimal PII extraction
risk_and_mitigations: Risk: extra synchronous work at auth time could add latency -> Mitigation: emit event asynchronously for non-admin/high-frequency flows; provide opt-in sync mode for high-assurance customers
Risk: storing too much PII in audit events -> Mitigation: default to token_hash_prefix + principal_id and require explicit label for PII retention
Risk: key compromise of signing key -> Mitigation: HSM-backed signing and auditable key-rotation policy
Risk: mismatch between SSO claims and internal role graph -> Mitigation: reconciliation job and onboarding checklist (SCIM + mapping templates)
Risk: large retention costs -> Mitigation: tiered retention and warm-to-cold storage lifecycle policies
deliverables: Spec doc (Confluence) for audit_event.v1 and canonical payload
Auth layer change to emit audit_event.v1
Console UI for viewing audit trails (search by request_id, principal, resource_path)
comments: 2026-01-12 - Ava Martinez: Initial draft submitted. Main open questions: sync vs async emission tradeoffs, canonical signing format, and PII policy. Asked security for review.

2026-01-19 - Nora Patel (security): Reviewed schema. Requested explicit token_hash_prefix to allow tracing without storing tokens and recommended HSM for signing. Flagged need for DPO input on PII retention.

2026-01-26 - Rohit Singh: Added design note to support an append-only sink implemented on top of our existing object-store with server-side immutability + periodic signed manifests. Will prototype async path first to measure latency impact.

2026-02-03 - PM review (Evan Li): Prioritized for next security release. Requested that console search surface correlation by request_id and a per-tenant retention setting in Console UI. Asked for stakeholder sign-off timeline.
2026-02-03 - Ava Martinez: Updated ticket to In Review and attached PRs. Security review requested and DPO loop started.
notes_for_reviewers: Please focus review on the canonical payload (fields listed), privacy implications, and performance constraints. We're aiming to keep decision latency impact <5ms for 99% of requests by routing events async for high-throughput endpoints. Enterprise immutable ledger is optional and will be gated by commercial requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Signed audit_event.v1 schema published in Confluence
Auth layer emits audit_event.v1 for allow/deny/elevation in staging
Immutable write path prototype that supports query by request_id and tenant_id
End-to-end test demonstrating correlation from SSO login -> role binding -> authorization decision -> audit event
Security review completed and DPO sign-off obtained for PII handling
